provenance: Independent original AArch64 instruction replay, not emulator-produced expectations.

contract.qualification: Actionable synthetic root-only roomless linkpad controller with genuine mate/remate bootstrap; not ordinary bind, child controller, calibrated mesh/CAN/485 or appliance simulation

execution.actual_instructions: Unicorn AArch64 original UDP handler, root dispatch, selectors, mbedTLS AES including round/key-schedule routines, base64, whitespace compaction, JSON constructor call sites, root property cache setters/getters and empty-topology serializer
execution.substituted_boundaries: cJSON parse/node/serialize API with original 64-bit type/valueint layout; libc/mutex/logging/string/memory/stdio primitives; source save_file runs through substituted fwrite/fsync without real filesystem writes; queue/FIFO I/O source runs with declared success. central_root.py supplies literal zero child SQLite count and accepts delete against a declared synthetic empty child database. No crypto primitive, root property handler, key selection or topology serializer hook.

wire.cipher: AES-128-ECB/full-block PKCS#7 output padding/base64; no IV/tag/GCM
wire.device_key_lifecycle: gree_init0x4585b4 loads persisted private_key from0x625ce8 to0x626411; if empty calls create_DeviceKey0x456bc0 for16 alphanumeric bytes and persists it. linkpad_status_init0x456e80 copies persisted key to remate metadata0x627795. mate itself does not rotate key.
wire.receive_limit_evidence: gree_indoor0x455a3c calls recvfrom(...,0x800,...). Source receive loop can split concatenated outer JSON before queue dispatch. Safe simulator accepts one strict outer JSON and rejects raw datagrams over2048 rather than imitating truncation/adhered JSON parsing.
wire.reply_scratch: indoor_reqJSON_udp0x44f030 has1024-byte plaintext scratch and1024-byte base64 scratch; final outer JSON is allocated cJSON output plus LF, no native fixed outer1024 allocation. Simulator must preflight inner and base64 includingNUL; any total output limit is explicit synthetic policy.
wire.scan: Clear {t:scan} yields i1/default-key encrypted dev metadata in transactions.json. cid inside dev is empty, name linkpad, mid80901, verV1.2.1, all brand/catalog/model/series/bc gree, vender2, lock0, mac root.
wire.mate_target_selector: None. indoor_handle_recvdata0x455418 branches on t:mate, reads host string and ignores cid/tcid/mac. Multiple listening80901 roots all respond to the same clear mate request, just as scan; route/broadcast to mate-capable roots, not to a fabricated tcid. Existing non-mate profiles must not receive invented bind support.
wire.mate_effect: Copies host string into persisted configuration and writes linkpad status, then emits selector8 remate with default key i1. Synthetic host should be bounded/sanitized; no real credentials or disk deployment state.
wire.ordinary_bind: No branch in finite parseIndoorPTJson dispatch; independently sent encrypted t:bind returns no datagram. Never fabricate bindok.

wire.status_routing: Root-safe requests use outer tcidROOT and inner macROOT. Native status also routes longer IDs through485 prefix/CAN caches; no root/child table inheritance. Strict root-only model rejects non-root targets instead of initializing/querying an absent child DB.
wire.command_routing: Root cmd has no sub, requires outer tcidROOT; inner mac is not consulted. p is root command parameter cache/strings, not appliance state. Replies res/mac/r200/opt/p. Unknown names omitted natively; safe simulator may reject unknown/invalid batches atomically.
wire.status_reply: dat/mac/r200/cols/dat; requested order and duplicates preserved. Exact-case property names. Root native cols ignores non-string or names length>=16. All known duplicate No placeholder entries match without values: never treat those as capabilities.
wire.topology: Inner {t:subDev,i:INDEX} yields subList/r200/c:0/i:INDEX/list:[] for every nonnegative model index. Native nonempty pagination five entries references separate CAN/485 state; root-only model permits no configured children. Distinct lowercase subdev addresses mesh topology, not this CAN/485 enumeration. subMid60 in remate is child-type metadata, not another emitted root MID.

timer_model.state: Per-device volatile in-memory multiple TIMERIDs, source SQL REPLACE equivalent: remove old row then append replacement; absent update inserts, delete unknown succeeds, restart empties. Query pagination preserves resulting row order and reports total independently. No actual DB or physical scheduled actuation.
timer_model.wire: setT/updateT/deleteT -> resT/r200; queryT -> listT/index/total/list. tz8/sec0 fixed. Source first cmd record and first mac/opt/p only. CMD comma->underscore and quote->pipe then inverse is deliberately lossy inside names.
timer_model.order: Source set/update ACK before SQLite write, delete SQL before ACK; chosen safe model validates entire operation and preflights reply before committing volatile state. No claim of database durability.
timer_model.safe_limits: id0..999, name128UTF8bytes/NUL-free, seven signed32week integers, hour0..23/minute0..59, short option and12hex target. Pipe collisions producing invalid JSON are rejected atomically. Query reply scratch limits remain preflighted; storage is not capped at one timer. Each row owns independent arrays as explicit chosen safe source-fault deviation.

boundary: SQLite count queries supplied literal0 and delete queries accepted against declared synthetic empty child topology; no hook on root properties, dispatch, crypto, key selection or topology serializer. libc sscanf%2X substituted. Native API calls record injected values. No physical CAN/485/mesh node inputs or semantics claimed.
safe_model_deviations: Strict one-object JSON; duplicate keys, concatenated JSON, nonfinite numbers and malformed cipher/padding rejected.
Clear mate host is1..255 printable nonwhitespace ASCII characters; mate ignores cid/tcid/mac/i/uid regardless of their type.
Invalid/unsupported command batches are atomic rather than native unknown-name omission or unchecked conversions.
Only balanced17 root getters; unsupported side-effect/name-only fields are omitted, not fabricated.
Root-only status rejects non-root identities and sub routing; no mesh/CAN/485 DB or children.
Pow integer0..65535 acknowledgment only; Meshid exactly4hex canonical getter; Unbind exactly12hex copied getter.
Synthetic zero/empty root globals and child count, no physical hardware state or appliance temperature.
